meta.name: red-team
meta.description: Stress-test a plan, brief or delivery claim against evidence and plausible failure modes. Use when the user asks for a red team or preparation for a consequential decision.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对方案和交付结论做对抗式挑刺,提前揪出会翻车的地方
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在拍板前把重要方案的压力测试做扎实
copy.tagline_en: Pressure-test a plan or delivery claim against evidence before you commit
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a high-stakes decision needs adversarial pressure-testing first

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先读取任务上下文契约与红队方法,再对你的计划、简报或交付声明做压力测试:对照证据、找出可能的失败模式,并区分实施、验证、部署与验收。
howto.when: 当你要求做红队审查,或为重要决策做准备时接管。若由 @fde 调用,会复用其已脱敏的上下文与范围,不重新开始设置。

say.text: 帮我红队测试这份发布计划,列出证据漏洞和可能的失败模式
say.note: 读取方法文档后给出压力测试结果

say.text: 对这份交付声明做红队审查,区分验证、部署和验收
say.note: 保留未知项,不臆测结论

say.text: 为这个重要决策做准备,找出简报里站不住脚的地方
say.note: 按任务上下文契约来推进

howto.what_en: Claude reads the task context contract and the red-team method, then stress-tests your plan, brief or delivery claim against the evidence and plausible failure modes, reporting gaps and unknowns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a red team, or want preparation for a consequential decision. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup.

say_en.text: Red-team this launch plan and list evidence gaps and failure modes.
say_en.note: Reads the method docs and returns a stress test.

say_en.text: Red team this delivery claim and separate verification, deployment, acceptance.
say_en.note: Keeps unknowns; does not invent conclusions.

say_en.text: Prep me for this consequential decision by red-teaming the brief.
say_en.note: Works from the task context contract.
